subject: GC reaper for orphaned orchestrator child processes (scripts/gc-stale-spawns.js + boot hook)
description: Durable backstop for the process-leak class (ScheduleWakeup sleepers, hung headless-drain claude/node children, stale subagent helpers). Add scripts/gc-stale-spawns.js (mirroring scripts/gc-worktrees.js + gc-filedrop-stubs.js): enumerate orchestrator-spawned node/claude children (match ORCH_SCHEDULED_TASK marker, headless-drain signatures, or a tagged env var), and kill those older than a max-lifetime (e.g. > their declared delay, or > 24h), sparing the live daemon.js + non-orchestrator processes. Wire it to run on daemon boot and on a periodic interval. Cross-platform process enumeration (Win32_Process / ps). Also: spawn ALL orchestrator children with a hard max-lifetime timeout + a discoverable tag so the reaper can find them. Consider surfacing an orphaned-process count on the dashboard.
